narrative_paragraphs: Online TRT (Testosterone Replacement Therapy) clinics provide end-to-end telehealth care. You complete an intake form, get blood work done at a local facility, consult a licensed physician via video, and receive prescription testosterone and supplies delivered straight to your door.
Online clinics operate on either a subscription or pay-per-service model. Cash pay is the standard, as insurance rarely covers TRT unless there is an underlying medical pathology.
